newsitem.title: UK: Prudential up after first half results.
newsitem.headline: Prudential up after first half results.

text.p: Shares in insurance group Prudential Corp Plc edged higher in pre-market trading on Monday, after the company released its half year results.

Prudential said pre-tax profits were 361 million stg for the first half of 1996 compared with restated profits of 499 million stg for the same period in 1995. Operating profits rose eight percent to 421 million stg versus 390 million stg in the first half of 1995.
Operating profits for Jackson National Life came in at 153 million stg for the first half compared with 118 million stg for the same period in 1995.

In the UK market, the company said it was looking to increase its customer base, expand its product range and broaden its means of distribution which it may achieve through acquisition and organic growth.
But some analysts said acquistion was most likely, and could include a building society and a life company.
